item.title: IPL 2026: Full list of injured and unavailable players
item.description: 19th season of the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 is set to commence on March 28 with defending champions Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) taking on Sunrisers Hyderabad in the opener at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium.

item.title: Yakutpura Government Hospital NOC Delay: MLA Majid Hussain Questions GHMC in Telangana Assembly
item.description: Yakutpura hospital NOC delay by GHMC raised in Telangana Assembly. MLA Majid Hussain questions delay despite government approval for hospital project.

item.title: Bharat Gas Godown Tension in Mehdipatnam: LPG Cylinder Delay Sparks Clash Between Customers and Staff
item.description: Bharat Gas godown tension in Mehdipatnam Hyderabad as LPG cylinder delivery delays spark clash between customers and staff despite no official shortage.

item.title: Hyderabad Bike Stunt Case: Two Youths Arrested Near Lumbini Park and Secretariat for Dangerous Reels
item.description: Hyderabad police arrest two youths for dangerous bike stunts near Lumbini Park and Secretariat. Motorcycles seized, strict action warned against reckless riding.

item.title: Hyderabad Rains Bring Big Relief from Heat, Traffic Affected in Some Areas
item.description: Hyderabad heavy rains cause traffic jams and waterlogging in Miyapur, Kukatpally, Banjara Hills and other areas. Commuters face difficulties amid sudden downpour.

item.title: Kavitha New Party Announcement on Sri Rama Navami: Telangana Jagruti Chief to Reveal Big Political Move
item.description: Kavitha new party announcement on Sri Rama Navami expected on March 27. Telangana Jagruti chief to reveal party details, symbol, and constituency.

item.title: No LPG or Fuel Shortage in India: Govt Urges Citizens to Avoid Panic Buying Amid Rumors
item.description: No LPG or fuel shortage in India, says govt. Petrol, diesel, and LPG supply normal. Citizens urged to avoid panic buying and follow official updates.

item.title: Iran Launches Missile and Drone Attack on Israel: Heavy Damage Reported in Tel Aviv
item.description: Iran launches missile and drone attack on Israel, causing heavy damage in Tel Aviv. Buildings destroyed and tensions rise in the region.

item.title: Hyderabad Illegal Coconut Powder Factory Busted: Task Force Seizes ₹21 Lakh Worth Stock in Begum Bazar
item.description: Hyderabad illegal coconut powder factory busted in Begum Bazar. Police seize ₹21 lakh worth stock and arrest accused for selling fake branded products.

item.title: Tree Falls on Car in Hyderabad: Vehicle Crushed Amid Strong Winds, No Injuries Reported
item.description: Tree falls on car in Karmanghat Hyderabad due to strong winds. Vehicle crushed but no injuries reported. DRF teams respond quickly.

item.title: Hyderabad Adulterated Ginger Garlic Paste Racket Busted: 3 Arrested, 70 Quintals Seized in Attapur Raid
item.description: Hyderabad adulterated ginger garlic paste racket busted in Attapur. 3 arrested and 70 quintals seized in Task Force raid exposing unsafe food practices.

item.title: Hyderabad LPG Price Protest: Congress Stages Massive Rally Against Rising Cylinder Rates
item.description: Hyderabad LPG price protest sees Congress workers and women rally against rising cylinder rates. Memorandum submitted demanding price reduction.

item.title: TGPSC OTR Update Deadline April 10: Final Call for Telangana Job Aspirants to Stay Eligible
item.description: TGPSC OTR update deadline April 10 is final. Telangana job aspirants must update details to stay eligible for upcoming recruitment notifications.

item.title: Hyderabad Shocker: Couple Kills Mother Over Relationship, Body Buried Under House Floor for Months
item.description: Hyderabad murder case shocks city as couple kills mother and buries body under house floor for months. Accused arrested by police.

item.title: Telangana Assembly Uproar: BJP MLA Rakesh Reddy Sparks Controversy with Remarks on Indira Gandhi
item.description: BJP MLA Rakesh Reddy remarks on Indira Gandhi spark controversy in Telangana Assembly. Ministers demand apology, Speaker expunges comments.
